title: The app id a pinned pane waits for has three homes
body:
Pinning copies the client's app id into `Kind::Anchor { app_id }` in `panes.rs`. The same value sits in `Pane.app_id`, which `commit` sets for the pane's own client. For a terminal pane the anchor id is `{prefix}{name}`, which branch 2 of `place` already matches by name and which restore rebuilds with `format!`. `save.rs` needs one match to fold the pair on write and another to split it on read. `Pane.pid` is the ghostty pid recorded at spawn; once the window arrives it equals `clients[0].pid`, and `save.rs` reads both.

## Proposal

`pinned: bool` plus the single `Pane.app_id`. `place` matches `pane.app_id` for any empty pane; terminals keep matching by name. Check the "waiting for" text and the restart path. Whether `Pane.pid` can go depends on the restart "still starting" check in `compositor.rs`.
